messages.subject: Non standardized estimates of the latents from a SEM model
parts:
Hello lavaan users,

I have the following problem:
I would like to get the non standardized estimates of the latents of my model but I can't figure out how to. 

Here is a dummy code and the corresponding dataset is attached to the post:
__________________________________
library(lavaan)
library(semPlot)


Products= read.csv("C:\Users\Admin\Desktop\KOS Joël\Datasets\HellerJoelDataset.csv", header = TRUE, sep = ";",fill=TRUE)

u="Gout =~ Item.Gout.1+ Item.Gout.3  
Texture =~ Item.Texture.1 + Item.Texture.4  
Noteglobale =~ Note.globale    
Noteglobale ~ Gout  
Noteglobale ~ Texture "

######################################################
#LISREL approach using the laavan package, and semPlot for the graph
x11(width =a[1],height =a[2])
model <- u
ProductsSTD=scale(Products[,c(2,3,4,5,6,7,8)])
fit <- sem(model, data=ProductsSTD)

print(summary(fit))
semPaths(fit,what="col",whatLabels="est",residuals=FALSE,title = FALSE,curve=0.5,nCharNodes=20,nCharEdges=20,sizeMan=9,sizeLat=9,
         edge.label.cex=0.8, curvePivot = TRUE)

fitted(fit)
parameterEstimates(fit)
fitMeasures(fit)
predict(fit)

________________________________________________________________________________

I get a fitted model, examinate some stuff, and then try to get the estimations of the latents using predict(fit)
The problem is that whatever I try I will only get the standardized estimations.
Does anyone know how to get the normal ones?

messages.subject: Re: Non standardized estimates of the latents from a SEM model
parts: I would like to get the non standardized estimates of the latents of my model but I can't figure out how to.

ProductsSTD=scale(Products[,c(2,3,4,5,6,7,8)])

If you want unstandardized estimates, why are you fitting the model to standardized data?

The problem is that whatever I try I will only get the standardized estimations.
Does anyone know how to get the normal ones?

Latent variables don't have an explicit scale, so you can give them whatever SD you think they should have.  But the predict() output should put the estimated factor scores on approximately the same scale as the latent variance estimates.

cov(predict(fit))
lavInspect(fit, "cov.lv")
